figurative_meaning_en: a great crisis or dire calamity
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পরিস্থিতিতে আমরা বেড়া আগুনে আটকে গেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: The entire country has fallen into a fenced fire.
In this situation, we are trapped in a fenced fire.
note: Idiom evokes imagery of being completely encircled by danger, common in descriptions of national emergencies.
